title: 宿骆氏亭寄怀崔雍崔衮
author: 李商隐
chinese: 竹坞无尘水槛清，相思迢递隔重城。秋阴不散霜飞晚，留得枯荷听雨声。
reference: In the bamboo grove by the clean poolside I stay;Separated from you by towns, I miss you far away.The autumn gloom undispersed and late frost remain;Only the withered lotus listen to the rain.
prediction: The poolside boat is free from dust;The water-side bower looks so clear.I miss you far away,I can't go to see you high above.The autumn clouds don't disperse;I hear rain on fallen lotus leaves at night.

title: 念奴娇
author: 叶梦得
chinese: 云峰横起，障吴关三面，真成尤物。倒卷回潮，目尽处、秋水黏天无壁。绿鬓人归，如今虽在，空有千茎雪。追寻如梦，漫余诗句犹杰。闻道尊酒登临，孙郎终古恨，长歌时发。万里云，屯瓜步晚、落日旌旗明灭。鼓吹风高，画船遥想，一笑吞穷发。当时曾照，更谁重问山月。
reference: Cloudy peaks bar the sky,Screening three sides of Kingdom Wu,A marvel on high.The tide flows out as far as I stretch my eye,The autumn water like a wall blends with the blue.I left the town with black hair; now I come againWith a thousand stems of snow-white hair in vain.The past gone like a dream,My verse would pour out as a stream.'T is said young General Sun oft came here with wineAnd crooned verse fine.To our regret early he died.Clouds spread for miles and miles over the riverside;The setting sun cast light and shade on Melon Isle.With the drumbeats the wind runs high;In my painted boat my thoughts fly.When can we beat the foe with smiles?The moon has shone on heroes of yore,But who would care for heroes any more?注释：
prediction: The cloud-veiled peak rises highTo block three sides of the pass;It's an object rare.The tide is reversedAnd rolls back on the beach.I see no more but autumn water girt with sky.Who would come back with green hair?Though he has white hair now,He can only dream of his past days.He follows like a dream,But still I find him in my lines.When will you drink your fillOf wine at Mount Guo?How could you not regretYour parting with me?A thousand miles away clouds rise up,At dusk they dimly appear,Their flags brighten when the sun goes down.The wind blows loud,The painted boat far away seems to laugh, swallowing all the poor.

title: 卜算子
author: 苏轼
chinese: 缺月挂疏桐，漏断人初静。谁见幽人独往来，飘渺孤鸿影。惊起却回头，有恨无人省。拣尽寒枝不肯栖，寂寞沙洲冷。
reference: From a sparse plane tree hangs the waning moon;The water clock is still and hushed is man.Who sees a hermit pacing up and down alone?Is it the shadow of a swan?Startled, he turns his head.With a grief none behold.Looking all over, he won't perch on branches dead.But on the lonely sandbank cold.
prediction: The crescent moon hangs on slender plane trees;Water clock stopped, people are at rest.Who sees me come and go alone?Only the shadow of wild geese far away.I start when startled, but turn my head to see.What can I do with grief no one understands?I pluck all cold twigs from branches high,But still I cannot find a place to take flight.

title: 小桃红
author: 杂咏
chinese: 盍西村杏花开候不曾晴，败尽游人兴。红雪飞来满芳径。问春莺，春莺无语风方定。小蛮有情，夜凉人静，唱彻醉翁亭。
reference: He XicunSince apricots bloomed, the weather drearHas disappointed the sightseer.Blooms fall like red snow over the fragrant way.I ask the oriole where is spring;It answers not and the wind dies away.Hear the young songstress singWhen all are still in the cool night!
prediction: He XicunThe peach blossoms blow before fine weather's done;No more come visitors to enjoy their bloom.The red snow falls on the path when spring birds sing.Why won't they stop?Why won't they ceaseTo let the wind calm down?The pretty maid sings at night,

title: 赠别二首
author: 杜牧
chinese: （其一）娉娉袅袅十三余，豆蔻梢头二月初。春风十里扬州路，卷上珠帘总不如。（其二）多情却似总无情，唯觉樽前笑不成。蜡烛有心还惜别，替人垂泪到天明。
reference: （Ⅰ）Not yet fourteen, she’s fair and slenderLike early budding flower tender.Though Yangzhou Road’s beyond compare,Pearly screen uprolled, none’s so fair.（Ⅱ）Deep, deep our love, too deep to show;Deep, deep we drink, silent we grow.The candle grieves to see us part,It melts in tears with burnt-out heart.
prediction: （I）She is light as willow leavesAnd blossoms just beginning to open on twelfth day of spring.The way she looks at the town’s fine sceneryIs more beautiful than those who roll up curtains to see her face.（II）Though fond of her, she seems unfriendly;Only when we drink together can I smile with pleasure.She sheds tears for me when candles burn down to ashes,For they seem to know my sorrow as well as mine.

title: 长相思
author: 晏几道
chinese: 长相思，长相思。若问相思甚了期，除非相见时。长相思，长相思。欲把相思说似谁，浅情人不知。
reference: I yearn for long,I yearn for long.When may I end my yearning song?Until you come along.I yearn for long,I yearn for long.To whom may I sing my love song?To none in love not strong.
prediction: Longing for you,I long for you.I don’t know when I can stop longing for you.I long for you,I long for you.How can I tell my dear friend what I feel?She who loves me not knows nothing of my heart.

title: （四）九煞
chinese: 有心待拜五侯，教人唤甚半州。忍饥寒攒得家私厚。待垒做钱山儿倩军士喝号提铃守，怕化做钱龙儿请法官行罡布气留。半炊儿八遍把牙关叩，只愿得无支有管，少出多收。
reference: He has a mind to be a baron high,But he is called as “rich as half a state” .Why should he bear hunger and coldTo pile up a mountain of gold?And hire guardsmen ringing bells at the gateFor fear his money-dragon away might fly?He would invite Taoist priests to use magic artTo keep it from flying apart.He snashes his teeth, walking to and fro,
prediction: He would pay tribute to five dukes with heart.He'd ask what they wanted for their state hard.Wearing hunger and cold he saved his wealth.His money piled up high, he asked soldiers to ring bells to guard it.They feared if it turned into money dragons,The magistrates would not leave it undisturbed.He ate eight meals without stopping his mouth;He only wished for more than less revenue.

title: 白雪歌送武判官归京
author: 岑参
chinese: 北风卷地白草折，胡天八月即飞雪。忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开。散入珠帘湿罗幕，狐裘不暖锦衾薄。将军角弓不得控，都护铁衣冷犹着。瀚海阑干百丈冰，愁云惨淡万里凝。中军置酒饮归客，胡琴琵琶与羌笛。纷纷暮雪下辕门，风掣红旗冻不翻。轮台东门送君去，去时雪满天山路。山回路转不见君，雪上空留马行处。
reference: Snapping the pallid grass, the northern wind whirls low;In the eighth moon the Tartar sky is filled with snow.As if the vernal breeze had come back overnight,Adorning thousands of pear trees with blossoms white.Flakes enter pearled blinds and wet the silken screen;No furs of fox can warm us nor brocade quilts green.The general cannot draw his rigid bow with ease;E’en the commissioner in coat of mail would freeze.A thousand feet o’er cracked wilderness ice piles,And gloomy clouds hang sad and drear for miles and miles.We drink in headquarters to our guest homeward bound;With Tartar lutes, pipas and pipes the camps resound.Snow in huge flakes at dusk falls heavy on camp gate;The frozen red flag in the wind won’t undulate.At eastern gate of Wheel Tower we bid goodbyeOn the snow-covered road to Heaven’s Mountain high.I watch his horse go past a bend and, lost to sight,His track will soon be buried up by snow in flight.
prediction: The northern wind sweeps up grass white;In August over the land snow falls like hail.The sudden fall of snow is as if it came down from high.The thousand trees and hundred pines look like pear blossoms spread out.In silk curtains and brocade screen the snow has left traces;Your coat too cold to warm your body, you wear your silken quilt.The bowstring on the general’s horn cannot be drawn;His iron armor still needs to be worn at night.The desert ice extends for miles and miles wide;The sky looks drear with clouds hanging far away.On the central camp we drink farewell wineTo play music on pipa, lute and flute.I see no trace of you when I come back to the gate;Only horse tracks remain on the snowy plain.

title: 霜月
author: 李商隐
chinese: 初闻征雁已无蝉，百尺楼高水接天。青女素娥俱耐冷，月中霜里斗婵娟。
reference: No cicadas trill when I first hear wild geese cry;The high tower overlooks water blending with the sky.The Moon Goddess and her Maid of Frost are cold-proof;They vie in beauty in moonlight over frosty roof.
prediction: At first I hear the wild geese fly southward;I cannot hear cicadas chirp any more.I climb up to the hundred-foot-high towerAnd gaze far away at water mingled with sky.The frost god and moon goddess both withstandThe cold of autumn night.They vie in beauty in the moonlit stream.

title: 山中问答
author: 李白
chinese: 问余何意栖碧山，笑而不答心自闲。桃花流水窅然去，别有天地非人间。
reference: I dwell among green hills and someone asks me why;My mind care free, I smile and give him no reply.Peach petals fallen on running water pass by,This is an earthly paradise beneath the sky.
prediction: Why do you come to my mountain high?I laugh but I feel at ease.I see peach blossoms flow with water clear;Beyond human world there’s another sky.

title: （二）
chinese: 利名无，宦情疏，彭泽升斗微官禄。蠹鱼食残架上书。晓霜荒尽篱边菊，罢官归去。
reference: Careless of gain and fame,To rank I lay no claim.Poet Tao would not in official work be lost,Nor let bookworms eat holes in his books,Nor his chrysanthemums be bitten by frost,
prediction: The mountainous heights have barred out the dust of the world;The land is bountiful after ten years’ drought.I’d move my house to enjoy the view from window highAnd hear the wind rustling with pine trees behind it.Now I’m old, I can only drink wine when awake.

title: 夜合花
author: 吴文英
chinese: 柳暝河桥，莺清台苑，短策频惹春香。当时夜泊，温柔便入深乡。词韵窄，酒杯长。剪蜡花、壶箭催忙。共追游处，凌波翠陌，连棹横塘。十年一梦凄凉。似西湖燕去，吴馆巢荒。重来万感，依前唤酒银罂。溪雨急，岸花狂。趁残鸦，飞过苍茫。故人楼上，凭谁指与，芳草斜阳。
reference: The bridge o'ershadowed by a willow tree,Orioles warbling over sunny bowers,Our ride was often sweetened by spring flowers.When our boat in delightWas moored at night,My tender love went deep into the land with me.We wrote verse line,Long we drank wine,And trimmed lamp wick:Time passed so quick.Can I forget our land or river tripBy rowing boat or flipping whip?Like dreary dreams ten years have passed.The swallows have flown over the Lake of the West,Leaving in ancient palace but an empty nest.I feel so sad and drearWhen again I come here.I call for silver cups of wine as before;Over the brook the rain comes fastAnd falling petals run riot on the shore,E'en the lingering crows fly across the sky vast.In the bower where lived my dear, alas!Who'd grieve at sunset over fragrant grass!注释：
prediction: The willow trees shroud the bridge at night;Maidens sing on ancient palaces fine.I often rode my horse to find you with spring sweet.When we moored our boat, I fell asleep in your arms.Wine cup longed for me, but words were short.We cut flowers from candelabra fast,To hasten wine cups to be filled up.To follow where you went before,I crossed the lake on boats light.The dream of ten years passed away like a songOf swallows flying southward over West Lake.How could I forget the place where we met?I still call for wine when I come back again.But now the stream is hurried by rain,And flowers wild along the shore.They fly over the misty skyWhen crows left their roosts in flight.

title: 沉醉东风
author: 送别
chinese: 关汉卿咫尺的天南地北，霎时间月缺花飞。手执着饯行杯，眼阁着别离泪。刚道得声保重将息，痛煞煞叫人舍不得。好去者，望前程万里！
reference: Guan HanqingWe stand so near yet we'll be poles apart soon;In a moment flowers will fall and wane the moon.We hold in hand the farewell cup,In our eyes tears well up.I have just said, “Take care to keep fit!”How painful is itTo tear myself away!
prediction: Guan HanqingIn far-off southern land you're as near as northern shore;The moon wanes and flowers fall away.In hand you hold my farewell cup of wine;Your eyes grieve to see me go.I say to you with broken heart, "Take care of yourself!"But how can I bear it?I wish you could go far, far away!注释：

title: 折桂令
author: 忆别
chinese: 刘庭信想人生最苦离别，唱到阳关，休唱三叠。急煎煎抹泪柔眵，意迟迟揉腮撅耳，呆答孩闭口藏舌。情儿分儿你心里记者，病儿痛儿我身上添些，家儿活儿既是抛撇，书儿信儿是必休绝，花儿草儿打听的风声，车儿马儿我亲自来也!
reference: Liu TingxinParting's the greatest grief in life, alas!Don't sing thrice the refrainOf farewell song of Sunny Pass!Worried to death, I wipe away my tears;At a loss, I stroke my chin and ears;Stupified, I shut my mouth tongue-tied.My love for you, you should keep in heart;Of ill and pain I would bear my part.Of household work, you need not care a grain.But don't forget to bring me word now and again!If I know you are in love with another flower,
prediction: Liu TingxinI think life is hardest to bearTo part with my dear friend.I wipe away tears when I hearThe farewell song at the frontier.Wiping my face with handkerchief,I rub my nose and ears with hands;My mouth is closed so that no word can be spoken.My heart knows what you feel for meAnd on your body pain has come down.The home you leave behindIs hard to go back again;Your letter's not worth reading or writing.What will happen to flowers and grass?

title: 早梅
author: 齐己
chinese: 万木冻欲折，孤根暖独回。前村深雪里，昨夜一枝开。风递幽香去，禽窥素艳来。明年应有律，先发望春台。
reference: Frozen are all the trees;Your warm root will not freeze.In the village’s deep snowLast night your branch did blow.Fragrance oozed in wind light;Birds peep at you still white.If you blossom next year,You will foretell spring’s near.
prediction: The trees frozen to death can't bear the cold;A solitary root feels warm alone.The village covered with snow deep is seen;Last night one branch of mume blossoms blows the wind.It wafts fragrance far and wide from afar;Birds peep at it as if they were surprised.At midnight next year I'll see it bloom again.

title: 白云泉
author: 白居易
chinese: 天平山上白云泉，云自无心水自闲。何必奔冲山下去，更添波浪向人间！
reference: Behold the White Cloud Fountain on the sky-blue Mountain!White clouds enjoy pleasure while water enjoys leisure.Why should the torrent dash down from the mountain highAnd overflow the human world with waves far and nigh?
prediction: Clouds rise and fall without care;Water flows leisurely on the plain.Why should they rush down from the hill to trouble people’s mind?注释：

title: 柳营曲
author: 金陵故址
chinese: 查德卿临故国，认残碑，伤心六朝如逝水。物换星移，城是人非，今古一枰棋。南柯梦一觉初回，北邙坟三尺荒堆。四围山护绕，几处树高低。谁曾赋黍离离？
reference: Zha DeqingComing to ancient capital,I find nothing but ruined wall,Grieved that Six Dynasties have passed like running stream.Things have changed and stars turned around;Men live not so long as towns stand.History is nothing less than a game of chess.Soon we wake up from our vain dreamTo find on northern land but burial mound,Which mountains on four sides surround.How many trees growHigh and low?
prediction: Zha DeqingI come back to my native land,I see broken stones on the ground.I feel sad for six dynasties like flowing water.The stars have changed,The city has passed away.How can I play chess with ancient kings?At dawn I wake from Southern dream;In Northern plain there's but a mound of earth.Wrapped around mountains four sides,Could trees grow tall or low?注释：

title: 黄河
author: 罗隐
chinese: 莫把阿胶向此倾，此中天意固难明。解通银汉应须曲，才出昆仑便不清。高祖誓功衣带小，仙人占斗客槎轻。三千年后知谁在，何必劳君报太平？
reference: Don’t try to make the muddy Yellow River clean!Could Heaven mirrored in the waves be clearly seen?How could a winding stream go up the Milky Way?Just out of Mount Kunlun, it is muddy like clay.In vain the emperor swore to narrow it down;Could a raft reach the Polar Star wearing a crown?Who knows if it will clear up after three thousand years?Why should you worry if clear or not it appears?
prediction:
The Silver River should be cleared up with crystal-clear mucus;It would still run turbid when it flows over the moon.The ancient emperor swore to make his sons great heroes;The immortal poet thought he could ride on floating stars.How many years have passed since then?Why should we care for the state of peace?注释

title: （三）十煞
chinese: 渐消磨双脸春，已雕飕两鬓秋。终朝不乐眉长皱，恨不得柜头钱五分息招人借，架上衵一周年不放赎。狠毒性如狼狗，把平人骨肉做自己膏油。
reference: The vernal hue on his cheeks fades away;Autumn frost is sprinkled on his hair by and by.His gloomy eyebrows frown all the day;He would lend at fifty per cent interest high.He wished the goods in pawn unredeemed a year long.As cruel as a wolf strong,He would press oil from people's bones
prediction: Gradually my face is worn away by spring;My hair turns autumn brown all day long.I wish I had money to pay for wrinkles old,I could borrow five percent interest on them high.The wolfish evil will not be appeased until it gnawsThe bones of those who have no friends or wealth.

title: 贺新郎
author: 辛弃疾
chinese: 老大那堪说。似而今、元龙臭味，孟公瓜葛。我病君来高歌饮，惊散楼头飞雪。笑富贵千钧如发。硬语盘空谁来听？记当时、只有西窗月。重进酒，换鸣瑟。事无两样人心别。问渠侬：神州毕竟，几番离合？汗血盐车无人顾，千里空收骏骨。正目断关河路绝。我最怜君中宵舞，道“男儿到死心如铁”。看试手，补天裂。
reference: What shall I say with my old age in view?I have but close relations and friendship with you.Ill when you came, I rose and crooned, we drank by day;The startled snow on the roof flew away.We laughed at rank and wealth as light as hair.Who would listen to our brave words in the air?I remember when night was deep,Only the moon into my west window would peep.We drank our wine againAnd played on lute in vain.Minds differ on one and the same thing.I would ask them an answer to bring.How many times has our sacred land been unitedOr divided?A fast steed used as a draft horse would lose its breath.Should its value be unknown till its death?I stretch my eyes to find the broken wayAnd admire you dancing before the break of day.A hero should not fear to look death in the eye.See how we tryTo mend the sky!注释：
prediction:
I am old,How can I bear it?Like General Yuan we have no common ground;Like Mr Meng our friendship is cold.I came to hear you sing and drink with delightAnd scatter snow on the roof high.You laugh at wealth as if it were but straw.How many people would listen to your hard words?Remember when only the west window sawThe moon brightening the village side.Wine cup in hand,I change my lute for flute song.We part ways without any difference between us.But how could I keep you from going eastward?When will you come back again?No salt-cattle cart has been sent to bury you far away.The frontier’s cut off where you left your bones.Along the riverside you dance at midnight,But I’m afraid you’ll break your heart like iron.Don’t forget to mend the sky broken by war!注释：

Note:
　　1.老大：形容年老。
　　2.元龙：指元好问，南宋文学家，诗人，学者，曾任翰林学士等职。
　　3.孟公：指孟子，战国时儒家代表人物之一，曾做过梁国宰相。
　　4.飞雪：比喻友人离去后的寂寞心情。

title: （二）得胜令
chinese: 翠立数峰寒，碧锁暮云间。媚景春前赏，晴岚雨后看。开颜，玉盏金波满。狼山，人生相会难。
reference: Peak on peak stands like emerald;Cloud on cloud locks the evening cold.Gaze on the charming vernal plainAnd sun-lit hills after the rain!O brighten upAnd fill to the brim with golden wine the jade cup!Deep in the hill,
prediction: Green hills rise high;Clouds dim the blue sky.The beauty of spring is seen;The rainbow after rain.Awakened from sleep,I see golden waves on my plate.Who can tell me,

title: 雁儿落过得胜令
author: 忆别
chinese: 乔吉（一）雁儿落殷勤红叶诗，冷淡黄花市。清江天水笺，白雁云烟字。
reference: Qiao Ji（I）Tune: Falling SwanThank you for your verse on leaf redIn cold place where yellow blooms spread.Clear stream and sky are paper white,
prediction: Qiao Ji（I）I'll write to you with red leaves on my heart,I'm cold and drear when yellow flowers blow.I'll send you verses written on clear river waves,And letters spread out like white wild geese over the blue sky.

title: 四块玉
author: 风情
chinese: 兰楚芳（一）意思儿真，心肠儿顺。只争个口角头不囫囵。怕人知，羞人说，嗔人问。不见后又嗔，得见后又忖，多敢死后肯。
reference: Lan Chufang（I）His love is true,His heart good too.I only want him to make it clear.If our love's known, I fear;Gossip makes me feel shy,Questions make me sigh.If he's not seen, I blame he's late;When we have met, I hesitate.
prediction: Lan Chuangfang（I）I am frank and sincere,I have a kind heart.I only care for my mouth not my throat.How can I bear to be known?How can I stand to be told?When asked, I feel angry.But when I see her face,I think of her beauty again.What will she do when I'm dead?

title: 塞下曲（其二）
author: 卢纶
chinese: 林暗草惊风，将军夜引弓。平明寻白羽，没在石棱中。
reference: In gloomy woods grass shivers at wind’s howl;The general takes it for a tiger’s growl.He shoots and looks for his arrow next morn
prediction: The forest darkened by wind startled grass;The general drew his bow at night.The morning he found white feathers on the stone.

title: 春望
author: 杜甫
chinese: 国破山河在，城春草木深。感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。烽火连三月，家书抵万金。白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪。
reference: On war-torn land streams flow and mountains stand;In vernal town grass and weeds are overgrown.Grieved over the years, flowers make us shed tears;Hating to part, hearing birds breaks our heart.The beacon fire has gone higher and higher;Words from household are worth their weight in gold.I cannot bear to scratch my grizzled hair;It grows too thin to hold a light hairpin.
prediction: The broken country still has mountains and rivers;In spring grass grows overgrown with weeds on city walls.I feel sad to see flowers shed tears when war is heard;I’m shocked to hear birds fly away from my native land.The burning of towns for three long months have passed;A letter home would be worth more than gold or silver.White hair I’ve lost can’t help me grow shorter day by day;My hairpins may fall out if I cannot fasten them.

title: 金陵怀古
author: 刘禹锡
chinese: 潮满冶城渚，日斜征虏亭。蔡洲新草绿，幕府旧烟青。兴废由人事，山川空地形。后庭花一曲，幽怨不堪听。
reference: The tide overwhelms the forge’s site,The tower drowned in slanting sunlight.The islet covered with grass green,And hills are veiled by a smoke screen.Man decides a state’s rise and fall,Hills and streams can do nothing at all.O hear the captive ruler’s song!How can you bear his grief for long?
prediction: The river’s filled with waves on the ancient town;At sunset I pass by the pavilion of war.The grass grows green on the new islet of Cai;In old days smoke rose from the hall where ministers were called.I think that rise and fall depend on human affairs;But mountains and rivers have no power to change their ways.After the Palace Flower song of the Jade Tree,I can’t bear to hear it any more.

title: 西江月
author: 辛弃疾
chinese: 明月别枝惊鹊，清风半夜鸣蝉。稻花香里说丰年，听取蛙声一片。七八个星天外，两三点雨山前。旧时茅店社林边，路转溪桥忽见。
reference: Startled by magpies leaving the branch in moonlight,I hear cicadas shrill in the breeze at midnight.The dcefields' sweet smell promises a bumper year;Listen, how frogs' croaks please the ear!Beyond the clouds seven or eight stars twinkle;Before the hills two or three raindrops sprinkle.There is an inn beside the village temple. Look!The winding path leads to the hut beside the brook.
prediction: The cuckoos startled from their nest at moonrise;At midnight cicadas chirp with cool breeze.I hear the fragrance of rice flowers sayWith frogs’ croaks that year will be rich and fine.The sky is dotted with stars as if they float;Raindrops fall like drops on hills when it’s late.A few years ago I passed by an old innBy the roadside under a tree near temple shrine;Now turning my head, I find the bridge over stream.

title: 菊花
author: 元稹
chinese: 秋丛绕舍似陶家，遍绕篱边日渐斜。不是花中偏爱菊，此花开尽更无花。
reference: Around the cottage like Tao’s autumn flowers grow;Along the hedge I stroll until the sun slants low.Not that I favor partially the chrysanthemum,But it is the last flower after which none will bloom.
prediction: The autumn garden looks like an orchid’s home;Around the fence I see it spread from day to night.The love of mine for chrysanthemums is no moreThan my love for poet Tao who loved them best.

title: （二）
chinese: 将来书信手拈着，灯下恣恣观觑了。两三行字真带草，提起来越心焦，一半儿丝挦一半儿烧。
reference: I take his letter near at hand,And read it by lamplight carefully.He wrote carelessly these two lines or three,Which I am anxious to understand.Half of his letter is torn apart,
prediction: The mountainous land is far away from the dust of the town;The village’s more prosperous than before.I’d move my house to enjoy the viewOf distant hills behind meAnd long-leafed pines on the other side.I’ll plant trees for ten years,And sow grain next year as I please.My children will take care of them all.The only thing left for meTo wake up when the moon shines bright,

title: 离思五首（其四）
author: 元稹
chinese: 曾经沧海难为水，除却巫山不是云。取次花丛懒回顾，半缘修道半缘君。
reference: No water’s wide enough when you have crossed the sea;No cloud is beautiful but that which crowns the peak.I pass by flowers which fail to attract poor meHail for your sake and half for Taoism I seek.
prediction: I cannot love water so deep as I have seen;I can't but think of cloud on cloud over Mount Wu.I am not gay to see flowers in bloom again;Half for my vow, half for you, I'm grieved to say.

title: 醉太平
author: 寒食
chinese: 王元鼎声声啼乳鸦，生叫破韶华。夜深微雨润堤沙，香风万家。画楼洗尽鸳鸯瓦，彩绳半湿秋千架。觉来红日上窗纱，听街头卖杏花。
reference: Wang YuandingNursling crows caw out cry on cry,Breaking the early day of spring.Last night the drizzle moistened the sand far and nigh,Thousands of homes sweetened by the breeze on the wing.The lovebirds tiles of painted house are washed clean,The colored ropes of the swing wet before the bower.I wake to find the sun redden the window screen
prediction: Wang Yuan DingThe cuckoo cries at dawn;It breaks the beauty of spring.The rain on sand is wet with night deep;Fragrant breeze blows over homes of all.The painted bower cleansed of lovebirds' nest;Half-damp swings hang from the screen.The sun rises when I wake up;I hear street sellers sell peach blossoms.

title: （三）采茶歌
chinese: 我几曾离这绣罗帏？没来由劝我道“不如归”！江南正着迷，这声儿好去对俺那人啼。
reference: O When have ILeft the embroidered screen?Why should you cryTo me: “Better go home!”My gallant in the south is entranced in love scene.
prediction: I have not left this brocade curtain so long;My husband says it’s better to go home now.The Southern land is all in bloom with flowers red,

title: 锦橙梅
author: 张可久
chinese: 红馥馥的脸衬霞，黑髭髭的鬓堆鸦。料应他，必是个中人，打扮的堪描画。颤巍巍的插着翠花，宽绰绰的穿着轻纱。兀的不风韵煞人也啊！是谁家？我不住了偷睛儿抹。
reference: Her perfumed pink cheeks look like rosy cloud,Her ebony chignon like black crows in crowd.I guessShe must be a songstressIn such a picturesque attire.Her emerald headdress quivers with each pace,Her dainty silken robe is large and light.How bewitching is she walking in delight!How could I not steal glances at her face?
prediction: Her face is red with flowers;Black whiskers like crows' wings her hair looks.The man must be a lover of hers.She's dressed as if painted by a painter.Her flower-like eyebrows tremble;She wears light veil to hide her face.I do not know who she may be.

title: 山花子
author: 刘辰翁
chinese: 此处情怀欲问天，相期相就复何年。行过章江三十里，泪依然。早宿半程芳草路，犹寒欲雨暮春天。小小桃花三两处，得人怜。
reference: Ask Heaven what I feel while parting here.When may we meet again? Oh, in which year?Thirty miles after the river disappears,Still I'm in tears.I take early rest by the grassy lane;Still cold in late spring, I fear it will rain.Two or three small flowers on the peach treeWin my sympathy.
prediction: I ask Heaven why I should be so sad?When can we meet again?Thirty miles from town I passBy River Chapter.I still shed tears on my way.The half of the journey is covered with grass green;It's late spring when it will rain.At places where there're two or three peach blossoms small,

title: 闺情
author: 李端
chinese: 月落星稀天欲明，孤灯未灭梦难成。披衣更向门前望，不忿朝来鹊喜声。
reference: The stars are sparse when sinks the moon before daybreak;The lonely lamplight not yet quenched, she lies awake.Not dressed up, opening the door with longing eyes,She complains of the false news announced by magpies.
prediction: The moon has set; stars fade away.The sky is about to brighten up.I rise from bed to see if I can dream.Why should crows bring me good news at dawn?

title: 酹江月
author: 文天祥
chinese: 乾坤能大，算蛟龙元不是池中物。风雨牢愁无著处，那更寒蛩四壁。横槊题诗，登楼作赋，万事空中雪。江流如此，方来还有英杰。堪笑一叶漂零，重来淮水，正凉风新发。镜里朱颜都变尽，只有丹心难灭。去去龙沙，江山回首，一线青如发。故人应念，杜鹃枝上残月。
reference: Immense is the universe.Could dragons be imprisoned in pools so small?How can we stay in wind and rain,In grief and pain?How can we bearCold crickets' chirp at the foot of the wall?Where is the hero, spear in hand, crooning his verse?And where's the talents' tower? AllHas vanished like snow in the air.Seeing the riverRunning forever,We need not fearNo hero would appear.Alas! Like wafting leaves, you and I,We come again to River Huai,When the cold breeze begins to blow.In the mirror we find a face aged in woe,But still unchanged is our loyal heart.Now for the northern desert we start;Turning our head,We see a hairlike stretch of land outspread.If my old friend should think of me,Listen to the wailing cuckoo on the moonlit tree!注释：
prediction: The universe is vast;I know you’re no fish in a pond.I’m grieved to hear of your gloomy daysAnd cold cicadas wail around.The sword in hand,I’ve written verses on the tower high.What can I do but sigh?What will come nextBut heroes rising from the sky?How could I laugh at a leaf so lightThat’s lost in waves again and again?It’s hard for meTo see my face in mirror old.How many rosy cheeks have faded away!My heart still burns with passion red.But when we part,Don’t forget to sing the song of cuckoo on the tree.

title: 宣州谢眺楼饯别校书叔云
author: 李白
chinese: 弃我去者，昨日之日不可留。乱我心者，今日之日多烦忧。长风万里送秋雁，对此可以酣高楼。蓬莱文章建安骨，中间小谢又清发。俱怀逸兴壮思飞，欲上青天揽日月。抽刀断水水更流，举杯消愁愁更愁。人生在世不称意，明朝散发弄扁舟。
reference: What left me yesterdayCan be retained no more;What troubles me todayIs the times for which I feel sore.In autumn wind for miles and miles the wild geese fly.Let’s drink in face of this in the pavilion high!Your writing’s forcible like ancient poets whileMine is in Junior Xie’s clear and spirited style.Both of us have an ideal high;We would reach the moon in the sky.Cut running water with a sword, it will faster flow;Drink wine to drown your sorrow, it will heavier grow.If we despair of all human affairs,Let us roam in a boat with loosened hairs!
prediction: Let go of me!The day gone by cannot be regained;What troubles my heart todayAre more than I can bear.The wind blows for miles on end to send autumn wild geese;I may drink till I drown in high tower blue.I have written articles as good as those of old;Between them comes another poet with clear hair.My mind is filled with boundless ambition and flight;We would pluck the sun from the sky or moon from the height.We could break the stream when we cut it off with our knife;But drinking wine to drown sorrow only makes us grieve.What can I do if life does not please me today?Tomorrow I'll float on my boat without a hat on my head.

title: 四块玉
author: 浔阳江
chinese: 马致远送客时，秋江冷，商女琵琶断肠声。可知道司马和愁听？月又明，酒又酲。客乍醒。
reference: Ma ZhiyuanWhen we two part,The autumn river is cold.The lutist's song would break our heart.Don't you know Poet Bai of oldWho listened to the lute with heart-break?The moon's as bright;We're drunken quite,
prediction: Ma ZhiyuanAt autumn river I see you go.I hear your song of broken heart on flute cold.How can I bear to know you're grieved?The moon is bright;I'm drunk with wine.

title: 一枝花
author: 秋夜闻筝
chinese: 班惟志（一）透疏帘风摇杨柳阴，泻长空月转梧桐影。冷雕盘香销金兽火，咽铜龙漏滴玉壶冰。何处银筝？声嘹呖云霄应，逐轻风过短棂，耳才闻天上仙乐，身疑在人间胜境。
reference: Ban Weizhi（I）On window screen the breeze sways shadows of willow trees;In wide sky the moon round casts plane's shade on the ground.On chiseled plate of gold incense is burned and cold;The bronze dragon sobs when icy waterclock throbs.From where comes the zither song?It's echoed loud and clear among the clouds for long.It wafts with the light breeze far and near.The divine music has just reached my ear,
prediction: Bian Wei Zhi（I）Through open window wind shakes willow trees;The moon sheds shadows on plane tree overhead.The incense burner is cold with smoke dissipated;The dragon drips water from jade-like fountain high.Where is the silver flute?Its song should spread to cloudlike height;It follows the breeze over short railings,And I would think it's heard above the sky,

title: 喜春来
author: 伯颜
chinese: 金鱼玉带罗襕扣，皂盖朱幡列五侯。山河判断在俺笔尖头。得意秋，分破帝王忧。
reference: Adorned with gold fish and belt of jade,I button my robe of brocade,Under black canopy and banners red,Of the five highest lords I'm at the head.The land is ruled at the tip of my pen.What pride over all men!
prediction: The golden fish with jade belt and brocade sleevesAre draped with five great ministers’ flags red and blue.Their pen can write down all mountains and rivers high;They break the imperial worries of autumn day.

title: 燕子来舟中作
author: 杜甫
chinese: 湖南为客动经春，燕子衔泥两度新。旧入故园尝识主，如今社日远看人。可怜处处巢居室，何异飘飘托此身。暂语船樯还起去，穿花贴水益沾巾。
reference: Another spring in boat I stay;Again swallows peck clods of clay.You know me in my native land;Now gazing from afar you stand.Ah, here and there you build your nest;Now and again I find no rest.You greet me and then leave the mast;My tears stream down to see you past.
prediction:
The second spring comes to my native land;Two times I see swallows build their nest anew.I know you have seen me as your master oldWhen you come back at the time of Spring Day now.You’re homeless where you’ve built nests here and there;How different from my floating life on stream!For a short while we talk with each other on the mast;But soon you rise again and fly away.Why should you care for flowers or waterways?注释

　　“旧入故园尝识主”，“旧”是对“熟”的古字，“识”是“知”的古字。这两句说，你曾在我故乡见过我，并且认得我是你的主人。“尝”是“曾经”的意思。这两句的意思是：你曾在我故乡见过我，并且认得我是你的主人。诗人用“旧”和“识”两个词来形容燕子，说明他对燕子很熟悉，因为他是诗人杜甫的朋友，所以诗人知道燕子也认识他。

title: 醉太平
author: 警世
chinese: 汪元亨憎苍蝇竞血，恶黑蚁争穴。急流中勇退是豪杰。不因循苟且，叹乌衣一旦非王谢，怕青山两岸分吴越，厌红尘万丈混龙蛇，老先生去也。
reference: Wang YuanhengI hate flies striving to suck blood,And black ants fighting for food.A brave man will retire at the high tide,And not follow the old rut or drift along.I sigh for mansions to lords no longer belong,And fear blue hills into hostile states divide.I dislike dragons mingling with snakes in the dust.
prediction: Wang YuanhengI hate flies that fight for bloodAnd ants that vie to make their nest.I know the hero who retreatsIn rapids when he sees danger near.He won't do what is not right;He's afraid of the old aristocracy.Who would be king if they were black?They'd divide the land with blue hills high.They're tired of the red dust on the ground,

title: 梧叶儿
author: 贪
chinese: 无名氏一夜千条计，百年万世心。火院有海来深。头枕着连城玉，脚踩着遍地金。有一日死来临，问贪公哪一件儿替得您？
reference: AnonymousYou weave a thousand plots one night,And plan for a hundred years bright.Your pit of hell is as deep as the sea.On precious jade you pillow your head,On a field of gold your feet tread.One day when death befalls you, see!

title: 山居秋暝
author: 王维
chinese: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。明月松间照，清泉石上流。竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟。随意春芳歇，王孙自可留。
reference: After fresh rain in mountains bare,Autumn permeates evening air.Among pine trees bright moonbeams peer;Over crystal stones flows water clear.Bamboos whisper of washer-maids;Lotus stirs when fishing boat wades.Though fragrant spring may pass away,Still here’s the place for you to stay.
prediction: The mountain is newly wet with rain;Late autumn comes to evening light.The moonbeams stream through pines clear;Clear fountain gushes on stones white.Come back from washing clothes girls sing;Fishermen row their boats at leisure.Spring fragrance may fade away;I can stay here as I please.

title: 哨遍
author: 看钱奴
chinese: 钱霖（一）试把贤愚穷究，看钱奴自古呼铜臭。徇己苦贪求，待不教泉货周流。忍包羞，油铛插手，血海舒拳，肯落他人后？晓夜寻思机彀，缘情钩距，巧取旁搜，蝇头场上苦驱驰，马足尘中厮追逐，积攒下无厌就。舍死忘生，出乖弄丑。
reference: Qian Lin（I）Can you tell truth from lies, the foolish from the wise?The miser stinks of gold since days of old.He is greedy for wealth at the expense of healthAs if he hated to have money circulated.He never feels shameTo thrust his hand to snatch money out of the flame,Or from a sea of blood upsurging high.How could he lag behind indeed?He contrives intrigues day and night,And seizes money by hookOr by crook,And seeks profit as tiny as the head of a fly,Or a grain of dust raised by the hoof of a steed.Insatiable to pile up wealth to his last breath,Careless alike of life and death,
prediction: Qian Lin（I）How can we distinguish between rich and poor?The money lord has called copper smell of dirt.Careless to seek for wealth, he would do anything.He will not let his goods flow out without stop.His face is covered with shame;He puts his hand on oil lamp to cook food.He stretches his arm to blood sea to fight foe.Why should he lag behind others who have more?All night long he tries hard to find an opportunity.When he finds one, he hooks it up with other opportunities.He drives away flies from the market placeAnd follows horses in dust wherever they go.He accumulates what he wants till he dies.But he's so greedy that he forgets life and death.

title: 沉醉东风
author: 春情
chinese: 卢挚残花酿蜂儿蜜脾，细雨和燕子香泥。白雪柳絮飞，红雨桃花坠。杜鹃声又是春归。纵有新诗赠别离，医不可相思病体。
reference: Lu ZhiBees gather honey from lingering flowers;Swallows build nest with clay wet with showers.Willow down wafts like snow white,Like rosy rain peach petals in flight.The cuckoos sing the parting spring.Though I write new verse when you part,
prediction: Lu ZhiAfter flowers bees have made their honey sweet;Fine rain with swallows fragrant they bring.The willow down like snow falls from the tree;Red raindrops fall on peach blossoms white.The cuckoo’s song brings back spring again.How can I write new verses to part with you?

title: 示弟
author: 李贺
chinese: 别弟三年后，还家一日余。醁醽今夕酒，缃帙去时书。病骨犹能在，人间底事无。何须问牛马，抛掷任枭卢。
reference: I left three years ago;Again I’m in my nooks.Tonight green wine aglow,I forget yellow books.Ill, I survive at last.What won’t happen on earth?Glad that the die is cast,I’m free from care or mirth.
prediction: After three years I come back to you;For one day more I stay at home.I drink wine with my friends tonight;I bring with me your books of prose.My sickly body still remains;Why should I care for what's done?Why should I ask if horses run?

title: 浣溪沙
author: 苏轼
chinese: 风压轻云贴水飞，乍晴池馆燕争泥。沈郎多病不胜衣。沙上不闻鸿雁信，竹间时听鹧鸪啼。此情唯有落花知！
reference: Pressed by the breeze, over water the light clouds fly;In pecking clods by poolside tower swallows vie.I feel too weak to wear my gown, ill for so long.I have not heard the message-bearing wild goose's song;Partridges among bamboos seem to call me home;Only fallen blooms know the heart of those who roam.
prediction: “Wind blows over light clouds floating on water;After rain swallows peck at mud to build their nest.”The author paints for us with ease a picture of spring fresh and new.The sky is clear after a shower;Swallows peck mud to make nests near the poolside.

title: 六丑
author: 周邦彦
chinese: 正单衣试酒，怅客里、光阴虚掷。愿春暂留，春归如过翼。一去无迹。为问家何在，夜来风雨，葬楚宫倾国。钗钿坠处遗香泽。乱点桃蹊，轻翻柳陌。多情为谁追惜。但蜂媒蝶使，时叩窗隔。东园岑寂，渐蒙笼暗碧。静绕珍丛底，成叹息。长条故惹行客。似牵衣待话，别情无极。残英小、强簪巾帻。终不似、一朵钗头颤袅，向人欹侧。漂流处、莫趁潮汐。恐断红、尚有相思字，何由见得。
reference: Again it's time to taste new wine in dresses light.How I regret to have misspent my time day and nightFar from home, far away!I wish that spring would stayA little longer, but fine springIs on the wing.Once gone, it's left no traces.I ask where are the flowers.They fell with ancient rosy faces,Whose fallen hairpins still shedA fragrance sweet. The peach path and willowy lanesAre dotted now with petals red.What loving heart would for them utter sighsBut match-making bees and message-bearing butterflies,Knocking from time to time at window-panes?The eastern garden in a shroudOf dark green cloud,The deep silence beneathThe deflowered tree is broken by the sighs I breathe.Its long thorned branches pull at my sleevesAs if to tell me how the flowers' parting grieves.I try to pin a little flower not yet deadTo the turban on my head,But it's unlike one on a golden hairpin new,Shivering and beckoning to you.O roses, do not drift awayWith tide or ebb by night or day!On broken petals red, I fear,There's message for a lover dear.
prediction: I try wine with my single gown;Grieved to find time wasted away.I wish spring would stay for but a while,And come back as if it had passed through the eye.Spring has gone without trace,Where is her grave?The night was filled with wind and rainWhich buried the queen of Southern land.The fallen flowers left behindHave fragrant traces on their way.They scatter over peach avenueAnd lightly fall down along willow lane.How can I love them any more?Only bees and butterfliesWould bring me news from far-off land.The east garden is silent now;It's covered with green grass dark and deep.I go around the flower bed,But sigh for what I see.It grieves me that the long twigsShould draw me aside like a handkerchief,To ask me why you should partWith me at such an hour!Though fallen petals may be weak,I'll still pin them up on my hat or cloak.Why won't they look like a hairpin which falls off?They're lost beyond your reach.Can they tell you when they fell?注释：

title: 得胜令
author: 四月一日喜雨
chinese: 张养浩万象欲焦枯，一雨足沾濡。天地回生意，风雨起壮图。农夫，舞破蓑衣绿，和余欢喜的无是处。
reference: Zhang YanghaoAll plants wither and dry,Rain falls to wet the earth.All revive 'neath the sky;The wind and cloud bring mirth.The peasants danceIn wornout cloak of bamboo.I'm happy in a trance,
prediction: Zhang YanghaoThe world is thirsty for water;A shower will quench all thirst.The sky and earth revive with joy;In wind and rain they'll do their part.Farmer, you've torn your green coat to shreds,And I'm glad to see it so wet.

title: 双双燕
author: 史达祖
chinese: 过春社了，度帘幕中间，去年尘冷。差池欲住，试入旧巢相并。还相雕梁藻井，又软语商量不定。飘然快拂花梢，翠尾分开红影。芳径，芹泥雨润。爱贴地争飞，竞夸轻俊。红楼归晚，看足柳昏花暝。应自栖香正稳，便忘了、天涯芳信。愁损翠黛双蛾，日日画阑独凭。
reference: Spring's growing old.Between the curtain and the screenThe dust in last year's nest is cold.A pair of swallows bank and halt to seeIf they can perch there side by side.Looking at painted ceiling and carved beamsAnd twittering, they can't decide,It seems.Clipping the tips of blooming tree,They shedThe shadow of their forked tails so greenAnd cleave their way through flowers red.Along the fragrant wayWhere rain has wetted clods of clay,They like to skim over the ground,Striving to be fleetIn flight.Returning late to mansion sweet,They've gazed their fill, till in twilightDim willows are drowned,And flowers fall asleep.Now they'd be perching deepIn fragrant nest,Forgetting to bring message from the end of the sky.Grieved, with eyebrows knit, the lady's seen to restHer elbow on the painted balustrade and sigh.
prediction: Over spring goddayThe silvery curtain is passed.The dust of last year has chilled the room.I am hesitating to stay where I am;I try to enter your nest side by side.But you fly up again on the eaves highAnd talk with me as if we were friends before.You will softly whisper to each other,Not knowing what to decide or say.At length you will pass through the air,Your green tail cutting red shadows apart.Fragrant path, rain moistens earthy mud;You love to fly down from trees to catch insects.You like to compete with others in flight,To show off how light and nimble you are.When you come back at dusk, you see all flowers fade.In vain you forget the letter from afar.How can you not be grieved?You lean alone on rails of balustrade.

title: 朝天子
author: 志感
chinese: 无名氏不读书有权，不识字有钱，不晓事倒有人夸荐。老天只恁忒心偏，贤和愚无分辨。折挫英雄，消磨良善，越聪明越运蹇。志高如鲁连，德过如闵骞，依本分只落的人轻贱。
reference: AnonymousThose who can't read are powerful,Those who can't write pass wealthy days,The ignorant may win high praise.Is it not Heaven's care to be just and fair?How can he not know the good from the fool?Why are heroes often frustratedAnd talents not utilized?The better they're, the worse they're fated.What is the use to solve disputeOr have a virtue mute?
prediction: AnonymousNo books can make you rich;No letters bring you power.No knowledge will win praise from others.You're praised for your heartless ways.But wise or foolish, they're alike.Careless of heroes' fate,Of good people's harm,The more clever you are,The less chance you'll have to do what you'd wish.

title: 贺新郎
author: 陈亮
chinese: 离乱从头说。爱吾民、金缯不爱，蔓藤累葛。壮气尽消人脆好，冠盖阴山观雪。亏杀我、一星星发！涕出女吴成倒转，问鲁为齐弱何年月。丘也幸，由之瑟。斩新换出旗麾别。把当时、一桩大义，拆开收合。据地一呼吾往矣，万里摇肢动骨，这话霸、又成痴绝。天地洪炉谁扇鞴，算于中、安得长坚铁。淝水破，关东裂。
reference: The people loved far less than goldLive on grass and vine old.Our vigor spent away, for peace we seekAcross the Northern Mountain peak.My hair turns white as snow,Ashamed I go,Like the princess sent to the frontierWith tear on tear.Lucky was Confucius old,He had Zi Lu, a disciple bold.If you came out with flags and banners new,And commanded an army in view,You'd gather ours or scatter hostile force.If you held your hand highAnd raised a cry,I would be prompt to ride my horse,And go for miles and miles and swing my arm,But this is only a fanciful alarm.The world is a furnace great,Where we may melt our fate.In a battle against the strong,Victory to the weak might belong.
prediction: From war torn land I would begin to tellMy love for my people who have no gold or silk.I am afraid they will be killed by weeds so thick.The young men of northern mountains can't see snow white.They blame me for losing my hair like grass green.My tears flow down as if turned back from east to west.Why should ancient kings fail to defend their western front?I'm glad that you're old enough to know what's right.You've changed our flag with new one, but we still fight side by side.We'll conquer the land when we hear your command.Now bones and limbs shake with fear of going far away.How could you stand up against the foe without help?Who would fan the furnace of heaven to make it hot?How could iron long last in an age of change?The Northern frontier was broken at the River Huai.

title: 水仙子
author: 倪瓒
chinese: 东风花外小红楼，南浦山横眉黛愁。春寒不管花枝瘦，无情水自流。檐间燕语娇柔，惊回幽梦，难寻旧游，落日帘钩。
reference: The east wind can't bring flower to her small red bower;The mountains bar the sky like eyebrows in green dye.The cold spring cares not of the slender blooming tree,The heartless water flows away, carefree.A pair of tender swallows whisper on the beam,Awaking her from her sweet dream.Where can she find her lover? Look!
prediction: The eastern stream veiled in vernal breeze,Outside the red bower of flowers I seeA brow-veiled southern shore with sorrow deep.The cold spring won't care for slender flower stems;Water flows without emotion or care.I hear the crows' sweet chirping on the eaves;I wake from my dream but can't find the place where I was before.The curtain falls when sunset sheds its ray.

title: 采桑子
author: 欧阳修
chinese: 群芳过后西湖好，狼藉残红。飞絮濛濛。垂柳阑干尽日风。笙歌散尽游人去，始觉春空。垂下帘栊。双燕归来细雨中。
reference: All flowers have passed away, West Lake is quiet;The fallen blooms run riot.Catkins from willow treesBeyond the railings fly all day, fluffy in breeze.Flute songs no longer sung and sightseers gone,I begin to feel spring alone.Lowering the blinds in vain,I see a pair of swallows come back in the rain.
prediction: After all flowers fadeThe lake looks fine with fallen red.The willow down is lighted up.In breeze on long bridge it's seen.The songs of flutes and pipes have ceased;No more people come to see.The curtain is drawn back;Two swallows come back from far away.

title: 闻王昌龄左迁龙标遥有此寄
author: 李白
chinese: 杨花落尽子规啼，闻道龙标过五溪。我寄愁心与明月，随君直到夜郎西。
reference: All willow-down has fallen and sad cuckoos cryTo hear you banished southwestward beyond Five Streams.I would confide no sorrow to the moon on highFor it will follow you west of the Land of Dreams.
prediction: When willow down has fallen outAnd cuckoos cry at night?I’ll send you my grief as moonbeams.Will they follow you to the west of the land?注释：

title: 咏怀古迹五首（其二）
author: 杜甫
chinese: 摇落深知宋玉悲，风流儒雅亦吾师。怅望千秋一洒泪，萧条异代不同时。江山故宅空文藻，云雨荒台岂梦思？最是楚宫俱泯灭，舟人指点到今疑。
reference: When leaves shiver and fall, I see the poet drear;Gallant and elegant, he is my master dear.Looking back a thousand springs, can I not shed tears?Desolate for long, we are not of the same years.His autumn song’s left in his old home by the stream.Did clouds bring showers for flowers in the king’s dream?Even the royal palace falls now in decay,The boatman points to the ruins in doubt today.
prediction: I know from fallen leaves that ancient scholars sigh;They were as learned and handsome as I am.I shed tears to see their splendor fade away;Their times have passed like those of my own day.Their eloquent words still shine on riverside;But they could not dream of the ruined palace high.Why should we care for what happened long ago?The boatmen point at it with surprise today.

title: 望岳
author: 杜甫
chinese: 岱宗夫如何？齐鲁青未了。造化钟神秀，阴阳割昏晓。荡胸生层云，决眦入归鸟。会当凌绝顶，一览众山小。
reference: O peak of peaks, how high it stands!One boundless green overspreads two States.A marvel done by Nature’s hands,Over light and shade it dominates.Clouds rise therefrom and lave my breast;I stretch my eyes to see birds fleet.I will ascend the mountain’s crest;It dwarfs all peaks under my feet.
prediction: The ancient sage asks how high?From east to west it towers high.The divine beauty of nature is displayed;It divides day from night on eastern slope.Its clouds rise up with my heart;I see birds go back to their nest.I will climb the summit highAnd view all mountains small.

title: （二）
chinese: 我事事村，他般般丑，丑则丑村则村意相投。则为他丑心儿真，博得我村情儿厚。似这般丑眷属，村配偶，只除天上有。
reference: Stupid in all am I,Ugly all in all is he.Our love is true though stupid and ugly are we.He wins my love despite his ugliness;He loves me for my stupidity none the less.Such a pair of ugly man and stupid wifeCannot be found in earthly life
prediction: The mountainous land is far away from the town of red flowers;The village yearns for abundant harvests.I would settle down to build my house near the window whereI can see the distant hills and pine trees behind it.Now I have planted ten years old trees and sown one year old grains.The children will take care of them all by themselves.When I awake at night,I only find the moon bright and wine cup filled with wine.

title: 锦瑟
author: 李商隐
chinese: 锦瑟无端五十弦，一弦一柱思华年。庄生晓梦迷蝴蝶，望帝春心托杜鹃。沧海月明珠有泪，蓝田日暖玉生烟。此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然。
reference: Why should the sad zither have fifty strings?Each string, each strain evokes but vanished springs:Dim morning dream to be a butterfly;Amorous heart poured out in cuckoo’s cry.In moonlit pearls see tears in mermaid’s eyes;From sunburnt jade in Blue Field let smoke rise.Such feeling cannot be recalled again;It seemed lost even when it was felt then.
prediction: The fifty strings of my lute have broken down;I think of my lost years with each string and fret.I know I'm but a butterfly in dreamsOf Zhuangzi who's gone astray;My heart as springlike is drowned in cuckoo cries.The tears shed on the waves of the sea turn to pearls;Warmth from blue fields turns jade into misty smoke.What can't be recalled now will be missed then?It was when you were gone that I felt so sad.

title: 水调歌头
author: 苏轼
chinese: 丙辰中秋，欢饮达旦，大醉，作此篇，兼怀子由。明月几时有，把酒问青天。不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒。起舞弄清影，何似在人间。转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠。不应有恨，何事长向别时圆。人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。
reference: How long will the full moon appear?Wine cup in hand, I ask the sky.I do not know what time of year'T would be tonight in the palace on high.Riding the wind, there I would fly,Yet I'm afraid the crystalline palace would beToo high and cold for me.I rise and dance, with my shadow I play.On high as on earth, would it be as gay?The moon goes round the mansions redThrough gauze-draped windows to shedHer light upon the sleepless bed.Against man she should have no spite.Why then when people part, is she oft full and bright?Men have sorrow and joy; they part or meet again;The moon is bright or dim and she may wax or wane.There has been nothing perfect since the olden days.So let us wish that manWill live long as he can!Though miles apart, we'll share the beauty she displays.
prediction: The moon has risen from when will it set?I drink to ask the blue sky why.The palace of the moon is unknown;How many years have passed there today?I would go up on the wind to fly away;But I fear the jade tower highWould be too cold for me to bear.I dance with my shadow clear and bright.How can I compare with those who stay awake?The moon should not have grief or joy like men;Why should it wax and wane at parting time?Human joys and sorrows come and go as they please;The full moon's face may change from day to night.But let us wish our lives long and far apart!We'll enjoy the same beauty of the moon afar.注释：

title: 卜算子
author: 严蕊
chinese: 不是爱风尘，似被前缘误。花落花开自有时，总赖东君主。去也终须去，住也如何住！若得山花插满头，莫问奴归处。
reference: Is it a fallen life I love?It's the mistake of fate above.In time flowers blow, in time flowers fall;It's all up to the east wind, all.By fate! Have to go my way;If not, where can I stay?If my head were crowned with flowers,Do not as me where are my bowers!注释：
prediction: Not loving life of pleasure,I'm like to be mistaken for a fallen one.I come back and go away as fate decrees.The Lord East will decide my fate or mine.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 晏殊
chinese: 槛菊愁烟兰泣露。罗幕轻寒，燕子双飞去。明月不谙离恨苦。斜光到晓穿朱户。昨夜西风凋碧树。独上高楼，望尽天涯路。欲寄彩笺兼尺素。山长水阔知何处。
reference: Orchids shed tears with doleful asters in mist grey.How can they stand the cold silk curtains can't allay?A pair of swallows flies away.The moon, which knows not parting grief, sheds slanting light,Through crimson windows all the night.Last night the western breezeBlew withered leaves off trees.I mount the tower highAnd strain my longing eye.I'll send a message to my dear,But endless ranges and streams separate us far and near.
prediction: The chrysanthemums grieved to see smoke rise from their leaves;The orchids shed tears when dew falls on them light.The curtain is cold with swallows flying away at noon.The moon doesn’t know what grief I’m in for night and day.It shines through red doors till morning light fades away.Last night west wind blew down green trees high.I go upstairs aloneTo gaze far and wide until my eyes can’t be seen.From letter to letter I writeMy heart’s desire to you.How can I find out where you are?注释：

title: 清平乐
author: 辛弃疾
chinese: 绕床饥鼠，蝙蝠翻灯舞。屋上松风吹急雨，破纸窗间自语。平生塞北江南，归来华发苍颜。布被秋宵梦觉，眼前万里江山。
reference: Around the bed run hungry rats;In lamplight to and fro fly bats.On pine-shaded roof the wind and shower rattle;The window paper scraps are heard to prattle.I roam from north to south, from place to place,And come back with grey hair and wrinkled face.I woke up in thin quilt on autumn night;The boundless land I dreamed of still remains in sight.
prediction: Around my bed mice gnaw;Overhead bats dance before the lamp.The wind blows down rain on roof high;The broken window speaks aloud.My life has been as happy as I wish.It's autumn night when I wake up;I dream of mountains far away.

title: 采桑子
author: 欧阳修
chinese: 画船载酒西湖好，急管繁弦，玉盏催传，稳泛平波任醉眠。行云却在行舟下，空水澄鲜，俯仰流连，疑是湖中别有天。
reference: West Lake is fine for us in painted boat loaded with wine.From pipes and strings comes music fast;From hand to hand jade cups soon passed,Secure on calming waves, drunk we lie.Fleeting clouds seem to float beneath our moving boat.The sky seems near to the dinersnow.Looking up and below, we will not go away.
prediction: A painted boat loaded with wine is good for pleasure;The pipes play music, strings sing songs of love.The cups are passed around to drink till you're drunk;Let your head fall on the pillow when you like!Over the waves float white clouds which seem to follow them;The water's clear as crystal, bright and green.They look so beautiful that they seem to be beyond the sky.

title: （四）四煞
chinese: 一个女孩儿转了几遭，不多时引出一伙。中间里一个央人货。裹着枚皂头巾顶门上插一管笔，满脸石灰更着些黑道儿抹。知他待是如何过？浑身上下，则穿领花布直裰。
reference: For several rounds a maiden comes forth and back,Then she leads a group of four from the rear.Among them there's a villain clown,Whose head is wrapped in a hood black,With a brush on the ear;Whose face with lime is white,Streaked with paint black as night.What will he do?From top to toe
prediction: The King of Kings comes to his native land;His attendants come one by one.Their job is to bring him grass for horsesAnd to send men to serve him with their hands.They wear silk robes embroidered on the sleeves,They know how he will be treated now?In the noisy market place they seeA man carrying an earthenware tray,Another holding a wine flask new washed,With head-dress made of paper and face painted with lime,He wears a silk robe embroidered on the sleeves.

title: 清江引
author: 秋居
chinese: 吴西逸白雁乱飞秋似雪，清露生凉夜。扫却石边云，醉踏松根月，星斗满天人睡也。
reference: Wu XiyiWhite wild geese fly pell-mell like autumn snow;In the cool night clear dew-drops grow.Drunk, I tread on the pine-tree's root steeped in moonlightAnd wipe the stone clean of cloud white.
prediction: Wu XiyiWhite egrets fly as if snow would fall;Cool dew on cool night grows cold.I sweep up cloud under stone sideAnd tread on pine roots drunk with moonlight.The sky is filled with stars when all are asleep.

title: 一枝花
author: 湖上归
chinese: 张可久（一）长天落彩霞，远水涵秋镜。花如人面红，山似佛头青。生色围屏，翠冷松云径，嫣然眉黛横。但携将旖旎浓香，何必赋横斜瘦影？
reference: Zhang Kejiu（I）Rainbow clouds fall from endless sky;Autumn's mirrored in far-flung stream.Her rosy face looks like flower in dream,Her flossy hair like far-off mountains greenOr colored screen.Roadside pines in cold emerald dye,Black brow overshadows smiling eye.Coming with my love fair and tender,
prediction: Zhang Kejiu（I）The rainbow clouds spread over the sky;The far-off water mirrors autumn day.The flowers look like faces red;The mountains seem to be heads of Buddha green.Wall-like screens with colors brightAre colded with pines in misty way;A woman's eyebrows archedWith a smile sweetly appear.But why should you not enjoy the fragranceAnd beauty of the flower?

title: 酒泉子
author: 潘阆
chinese: 长忆观潮，满郭人争江上望。来疑沧海尽成空，万面鼓声中。弄潮儿向涛头立，手把红旗旗不湿。别来几向梦中看，梦觉尚心寒。
reference: I still remember watching tidal bore,The town poured out on river shore.It seemed the sea had emptied all its water here,And thousands of drums were beating far and near.At the crest of huge billows the swimmers did stand,Yet dry remained red flags they held in hand.Come back, I saw in dreams the tide o'erflow the river,Awake, I feel my heart with fear still shiver.
prediction: I often remember viewing the waves on the beach.When all along the shore people come to gaze at them as ifThe sea had turned empty like a dream of olden days.The drumbeats beat with music in the breezeAnd those who ride the waves stand on crest of the wave high.Hands holding red flags dry, they still look so proud.I can't forget seeing the lake in my dreams again;When I wake up from sleep, I feel cold in heart.

title: 古从军行
author: 李颀
chinese: 白日登山望烽火，黄昏饮马傍交河。行人刁斗风沙暗，公主琵琶幽怨多。野营万里无城郭，雨雪纷纷连大漠。胡雁哀鸣夜夜飞，胡儿眼泪双双落。闻道玉门犹被遮，应将性命逐轻车。年年战骨埋荒外，空见葡萄入汉家。
reference: We climb up mountains to watch for beacon fires,And water horses by riverside when day expires.We beat the gong in sand-darkened land where wind blows,And hear the pipa tell the princess’ secret woe.There is no town for miles and miles but tents in rows;Beyond the desert there’s nothing but rain and snow.The wild geese honk from night to night, that’s all we hear;We see but Tartar soldiers shedding tear on tear.’Tis said we cannot go back through the Jade Gate Pass;We’d risk our lives to follow war-chariots, alas!The dead are buried in the desert year by year,Only to bring back grapes from over the frontier.
prediction: The sun is high when I climb up the hill to see烽火;At dusk my horse drinks water near the river of war.The wind blows sand down on the road where travelers pass;The princess’ lute plays a song of sorrow deep and wide.Wilderness spreads for miles without any town or fort;It rains and snows over the desert far and nigh.Cicadas cry at night from time to time in flight;The soldiers shed tears like raindrops one by one.I hear that the way to the capital has been blocked;They will follow their general’s orders to fight hard year after year.Their bones buried in waste land year after year,Only grapes come back to the kingdom with ease.

title: 钗头凤
author: 陆游
chinese: 红酥手，黄縢酒，满城春色宫墙柳。东风恶，欢情薄。一怀愁绪，几年离索。错，错，错。春如旧，人空瘦，泪痕红浥鲛绡透。桃花落，闲池阁。山盟虽在，锦书难托。莫，莫，莫！
reference: Pink hands so fine,Gold-branded wine,Spring paints the willows green palace walls can't confine.East wind unfair,Happy times rare.In my heart sad thoughts throng;We've been separated for years long.Wrong, wrong, wrong!Spring is as green,In vain she's lean.Her kerchief soaked with tears and red with stains unclean.Peach blossoms fallNear deserted hall.Our oath is still there. Lo!No words to her can go.No, no, no!注释：

title: 塞鸿秋
author: 代人作
chinese: 贯云石战西风几点宾鸿至，感起我南朝千古伤心事。展花笺欲写几句知心事，空教我停霜毫半晌无才思。往常得兴时，一扫无瑕疵。今日个病厌厌刚写下两个相思字。

title: 游子吟
author: 孟郊
chinese: 慈母手中线，游子身上衣。临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归。谁言寸草心，报得三春晖。
reference: From the threads a mother’s hand weaves,A gown for parting son is made.Sown stitch by stitch before he leaves,For fear his return be delayed.Such kindness as young grass receivesFrom the warm sun can’t be repaid.
prediction:
A needlework thread is woven into a garment for my son.I fear he will come back late to see it done with care.

　　“线”与“衣”两件极常见的东西把“慈母”和“游子”的关系形象地表达出来。“线”是缝衣的工具，“衣”是缝好的衣物。这两句诗以“线”喻“母”，以“衣”喻“子”，使读者容易理解，又易于产生联想，从而加深对诗句的理解。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 辛弃疾
chinese: 陌上柔桑破嫩芽。东邻蚕种已生些。平冈细草鸣黄犊，斜日寒林点暮鸦。山远近，路横斜。青旗沽酒有人家。城中桃李愁风雨，春在溪头荠菜花。
reference: The tender twigs begin to spout along the lane;The silkworm's eggs of my east neighbor have come out.The yellow calves grazing fine grass bawl on the plain;At sunset in the cold forest crows fly about.The mountains extend far and near;Lanes crisscross there and here.Blue streamers fly where wine shops appear.Peach and plum blossoms in the town fear wind and showers,But spring dwells by the creekside where blossom wildflowers.
prediction: The road is far away from town where I’m going;East of my neighbor grows some silkworm seed.The grass on gentle slope rustles with yellow calf’s cry;At dusk over the cold wood dots of evening crows fly.Seeing hills rise and fall,And roads at right angles go.Who would not buy wine by the green flag?In city there’s fear of rain or wind around spring flowers.But along the stream we’ll find the vernal day.

title: 四块玉
author: 叹世
chinese: 马致远两鬓皤，中年过，因甚区区苦张罗?人间宠辱都参破。种春风二顷田，远红尘千丈波，倒大来闲快活。
reference: Ma ZhiyuanGrey turns my hairPast middle age.Why should I be busy about worldly affair?I've seen through fame and shame as a sage.I'd till in vernal breeze two acres of land;Far from the world's ups and downs I would stand.What a great pleasure

title: 八声甘州
author: 辛弃疾
chinese: 夜读《李广传》，不能寐。因念晁楚老、杨民瞻约同居山间，戏用李广事，赋以寄之。故将军饮罢夜归来，长亭解雕鞍。恨灞陵醉尉，匆匆未识，桃李无言。射虎山横一骑，裂石响惊弦。落魄封侯事，岁晚田间。谁向桑麻杜曲，要短衣匹马，移住南山。看风流慷慨，谈笑过残年。汉开边、功名万里，甚当时、健者也曾闲。纱窗外、斜风细雨，一阵轻寒。
reference: Xin QijiThe Flying General was famed for his force.When drunk, he came back at night,At Long Pavilion unsaddled his horse.But the officer drunk knew not the hero bright,So the general stood without speechLike plum or peach.His galloping steedCrossed the mountain in speed,Taking a rock for a tiger, he twanged his string tightAnd pierced the stone.Not ennobled late in years, unknown,He lived in countryside, alone.Who would live in the fields with wine,In short coat or on a horse fine,And move to the foot of the southern hill?Valiant and fervent still,I'd pass in laughter the rest of my years.On the thousand-mile-long frontiers,How many generals won a name!But the strongest was not ennobled with his fame.Out of my window screen the slanting breezeAnd drizzling rain would freeze.
prediction: The general drank his fill at nightAnd came back to camp with saddle unfastened.He regretted that he was drunk before the chief of guard who had insulted him;He would have known him if they had met on the way.The hero shot down tigers from horseback,But arrows broke the stone as if strings were broken.They could not be promoted to high rank when old,So they moved to live in the mountain side where mulberry trees grew.Looking at their flowing hair and riding on their steeds,They lived happily till they died old, laughing and talking all day long.Their fame spread far and wide, but few men then were brave enough to defend the border.However hard they worked, they were still left idle.When it rained fine outside the window, cold breeze blew light.

title: 赤壁
author: 杜牧
chinese: 折戟沉沙铁未销，自将磨洗认前朝。东风不与周郎便，铜雀春深锁二乔。
reference: We dig out broken halberds buried in the sandAnd wash and rub these relics of an ancient war.Had the east wind refused General Zhou a helping hand,His foe’d have locked his fair wife on Northern shore.
prediction: The broken spear buried in sand has not been worn out;I'll wash it to find out what happened long ago.The east wind would have favored General Zhou's plan,But two princesses locked in palace could not stand.

title: 虞美人
author: 苏轼
chinese: 波声拍枕长淮晓，隙月窥人小。无情汴水自东流，只载一船离恨向西州。竹溪花浦曾同醉，酒味多于泪。谁教风鉴在尘埃？酝造一场烦恼送人来！
reference: River Huai's waves seem to beat my pillow till dawn;A ray of moonbeam peeps at me forlorn.The heartless River Bian flows eastward down,Laden with parting grief, you've left the town.Once we got drunk by riverside bamboo and flower,My tears made sweet wine sour.How could a mirror not be stained with dust?Who could predict the trouble brewing up in gust?注释：

　　①淮：指淮河，长江支流之一。②隙月：缝隙中的月亮。③汴水：汴河，今称大运河，发源于河南开封，经洛阳至扬州，是古代南北交通的大道。
